framework.name: SOC 2 Type II (AICPA Trust Services Criteria)
framework.source_annex: AICPA Trust Services Criteria for Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy

controls.title: Control Environment - Integrity and Ethical Values
controls.description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values through defined code of conduct, leadership oversight, and compliance policies.
evidence_checklist: Approved Code of Conduct and Ethics Policy
Signed Employee Code of Conduct Acknowledgments
Whistleblower Policy and Incident Intake Log
controls.remediation_guidance: Publish an executive-approved Code of Conduct policy and require all personnel to sign an acknowledgment annually.

controls.title: Control Environment - Independent Board Oversight
controls.description: The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight of the development and performance of internal control.
evidence_checklist: Board of Directors Charter and Meeting Minutes
Audit Committee Quarterly Security Review Records
controls.remediation_guidance: Form a security audit committee and document quarterly board meeting reviews of cybersecurity metrics.

controls.title: Control Environment - Organizational Structure & Accountability
controls.description: Management establishes, with board oversight, structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities and responsibilities in pursuit of security objectives.
evidence_checklist: Organizational Chart and Security Officer Designation
Documented Job Descriptions with Security Responsibilities
controls.remediation_guidance: Define CISO/Security Lead reporting lines and document explicit security duties in position descriptions.

controls.title: Control Environment - Commitment to Competence
controls.description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals in alignment with security responsibilities.
evidence_checklist: Background Check Policy and Verification Logs
Security Team Professional Certifications Register
controls.remediation_guidance: Mandate background checks prior to employment and track security certifications (e.g. CISSP, CISM, CEH).

controls.title: Control Environment - Internal Control Accountability
controls.description: The entity holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities in the pursuit of objectives.
evidence_checklist: Annual Performance Appraisal Forms with Security Criteria
Disciplinary Action Policy and Enforcement Records
controls.remediation_guidance: Incorporate security compliance metrics into annual performance evaluations.

controls.title: Communication & Information - Internal Communication
controls.description: The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control, communicating security roles internally.
evidence_checklist: Security Awareness Training Platform Completion Logs
New Hire Security Onboarding Curriculum & Records
controls.remediation_guidance: Conduct annual mandatory security training for 100% of staff and maintain automated completion tracking.

controls.title: Communication & Information - Communication of Objectives
controls.description: The entity internally communicates information, including objectives and responsibilities for internal control, necessary to support the functioning of internal control.
evidence_checklist: Internal Security Policy Portal Accessibility Records
Quarterly Security All-Hands Presentation Decks
controls.remediation_guidance: Host an internal policy knowledgebase accessible to all employees.

controls.title: Communication & Information - External Communication
controls.description: The entity communicates with external parties regarding matters affecting the functioning of internal control and security incidents.
evidence_checklist: Customer Security Terms & SLA Documentation
External Vulnerability Disclosure / Responsible Disclosure Policy
controls.remediation_guidance: Publish a security advisory page and security vulnerability disclosure submission channel.

controls.title: Risk Assessment - Specification of Objectives
controls.description: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable the identification and assessment of risks relating to security objectives.
evidence_checklist: Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework Document
Information Security Risk Acceptance Criteria
controls.remediation_guidance: Formulate a formal risk management methodology specifying risk impact and likelihood scoring.

controls.title: Risk Assessment - Identification and Analysis of Risk
controls.description: The entity identifies risks to the achievement of its objectives across the entity and analyzes risks as a basis for determining how the risks should be managed.
evidence_checklist: Annual Information Security Risk Register
Threat Modeling Artifacts for Critical Architecture
controls.remediation_guidance: Execute an annual enterprise risk assessment and maintain an active Risk Register.

controls.title: Risk Assessment - Fraud Risk Evaluation
controls.description: The entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks to the achievement of objectives, including insider threats and unauthorized data extraction.
evidence_checklist: Fraud Risk Assessment Document
DLP / Data Exfiltration Risk Controls Review
controls.remediation_guidance: Include insider threat and data exfiltration scenarios in risk assessments.

controls.title: Risk Assessment - Assessment of Significant Changes
controls.description: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact the system of internal control, including infrastructure and architectural changes.
evidence_checklist: Architecture Review Board (ARB) Sign-off Records
Major Change Security Assessment Reports
controls.remediation_guidance: Perform risk assessments before deploying major infrastructure or architectural refactors.

controls.title: Monitoring Activities - Ongoing and Separate Evaluations
controls.description: The entity selects, develops, and performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations to ascertain whether internal controls are present and functioning.
evidence_checklist: Internal Audit Schedule and Audit Reports
Quarterly Vulnerability Scanning & Penetration Testing Reports
controls.remediation_guidance: Run weekly automated compliance scans and schedule annual third-party penetration tests.

controls.title: Monitoring Activities - Evaluation and Reporting Deficiencies
controls.description: The entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies in a timely manner to those parties responsible for taking corrective action.
evidence_checklist: Remediation Tracking Matrix (CAPA / Jira SLA Logs)
Quarterly Vulnerability SLA Adherence Summary
controls.remediation_guidance: Enforce vulnerability remediation SLAs (Critical: 7 days, High: 30 days) with automatic escalation.

controls.title: Control Activities - Selection & Development of Control Activities
controls.description: The entity selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives to acceptable levels.
evidence_checklist: Comprehensive Information Security Policy Suite
Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) for System Admin
controls.remediation_guidance: Maintain a approved security policy framework reviewed annually.

controls.title: Control Activities - Selection of Technology Controls
controls.description: The entity selects and develops general control activities over technology to support the achievement of objectives.
evidence_checklist: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Hardening Repositories
Automated Endpoint Compliance Configuration Baselines
controls.remediation_guidance: Deploy automated configuration management (Ansible/Terraform) enforcing baseline security parameters.

controls.title: Control Activities - Deployment Through Policies & Procedures
controls.description: The entity deploys control activities through policies that establish what is expected and procedures that put policies into action.
evidence_checklist: Policy Revision History Log
Management Approval Sign-offs on Security Procedures
controls.remediation_guidance: Document policy version history and management approval sign-offs for all procedural updates.

controls.title: Logical & Physical Access Controls - Logical Access Infrastructure
controls.description: The entity restricts logical access to infrastructure, software, and data to authorized users via unique credentials and RBAC.
evidence_checklist: Identity & Access Management (IdP / Okta / Azure AD) User Directory List
Quarterly User Access Review Sign-offs
controls.remediation_guidance: Implement centralized SSO with Mandatory Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for all system access.

controls.title: Logical Access - User Registration and Offboarding
controls.description: Prior to issuing credentials, the entity registers and authorizes new users, and promptly revokes credentials upon termination or transfer.
evidence_checklist: Access Request Ticket Samples (Jira / ServiceNow)
Employee Offboarding Checklist & Deprovisioning Timestamp Logs
controls.remediation_guidance: Automate account deprovisioning via SCIM/IdP integration upon HR status update.

controls.title: Logical Access - Principle of Least Privilege
controls.description: The entity authorizes, modifies, and revokes access permissions based on role requirements and least privilege principles.
evidence_checklist: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Role Definition Matrix
Privileged Access Management (PAM) Configuration Logs
controls.remediation_guidance: Remove default administrator permissions and restrict root access using just-in-time privilege escalation.

controls.title: Physical Access - Data Center and Office Security
controls.description: The entity restricts physical access to facilities, data centers, and physical assets containing system infrastructure.
evidence_checklist: Data Center Host / Cloud Provider SOC 1 & SOC 2 Type II Audit Reports
Office Keycard Access Badge Logs & Visitor Sign-in Books
controls.remediation_guidance: Obtain annual SOC 2 reports from cloud infrastructure providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) and review physical security controls.

controls.title: Logical Access - Asset Disposal & Sanitization
controls.description: The entity disposes of physical assets and media containing confidential data securely to prevent unauthorized recovery.
evidence_checklist: Certificate of Destruction for Physical Storage Media
Cryptographic Erasure Policy for Decommissioned Cloud Disks
controls.remediation_guidance: Enforce NIST SP 800-88 compliant sanitization and retain digital destruction certificates.

controls.title: Logical Access - Boundary Protection & Network Segmentation
controls.description: The entity protects logical boundaries against unauthorized traffic using firewalls, security groups, and network segmentation.
evidence_checklist: Network Architecture Topology Diagram
VPC Security Group Rules & Firewall Rule Configuration Export
controls.remediation_guidance: Disable default allow-all inbound security group rules; block public access to internal database/SSH ports.

controls.title: Logical Access - Data Encryption in Transit & Rest
controls.description: The entity uses encryption protocols to protect data during transmission over public networks and at rest in storage repositories.
evidence_checklist: TLS Configuration Scan Results (TLS 1.2+ Only)
Storage Bucket & Database AES-256 Encryption Status Exports
controls.remediation_guidance: Enforce TLS 1.3/1.2 on all endpoints, disable weak ciphers, and turn on default KMS AES-256 encryption at rest.

controls.title: Logical Access - Malicious Code Prevention
controls.description: The entity detects and prevents malicious code, malware, and unauthorized software execution on endpoints and infrastructure.
evidence_checklist: Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR / Antivirus) Fleet Coverage Report
Automated Malware Signature Update Verification Logs
controls.remediation_guidance: Deploy EDR agents on 100% of fleet endpoints with automatic signature updates and real-time blocking.

controls.title: System Operations - Vulnerability Identification and Management
controls.description: The entity conducts vulnerability scans and patch evaluations to identify and remediate security weaknesses continuously.
evidence_checklist: Weekly Automated Container & Host Vulnerability Scan Reports
CVE Patch Management Status Reports
controls.remediation_guidance: Integrate container image scanning into CI/CD pipelines and apply security patches within SLA windows.

controls.title: System Operations - Security Monitoring & Anomaly Detection
controls.description: The entity monitors system components and operational performance to detect anomalies, security alerts, and unauthorized changes.
evidence_checklist: SIEM / Centralized Logging Pipeline Configuration Export
Alert Notification Thresholds & Escalation Matrix
controls.remediation_guidance: Stream system and application logs to a centralized SIEM with active alert rules for privilege escalation.

controls.title: System Operations - Incident Evaluation & Response
controls.description: The entity evaluates security incidents and executes incident response procedures to contain and remediate security events.
evidence_checklist: Incident Response Plan (IRP) Document
Annual Incident Response Tabletop Exercise Minutes & Lessons Learned Log
controls.remediation_guidance: Conduct an annual incident response tabletop exercise and document containment procedures.

controls.title: System Operations - Incident Recovery & Communication
controls.description: The entity responds to identified security incidents by communicating with affected parties and restoring affected systems.
evidence_checklist: Post-Mortem / RCA Reports for Past Incidents
Customer Security Incident Notification Template
controls.remediation_guidance: Establish a post-mortem process for critical incidents with root-cause analysis documentation.

controls.title: System Operations - Operational Maintenance & Capacity
controls.description: The entity performs regular maintenance and monitors system capacity to ensure ongoing operational stability.
evidence_checklist: System Resource Utilization Dashboard Screenshots (CPU/Memory/Disk)
Auto-Scaling Policy & Capacity Alert Configuration
controls.remediation_guidance: Configure automated resource capacity alerting when disk or memory utilization exceeds 80%.

controls.title: Change Management - Software & Infrastructure Changes
controls.description: The entity authorizes, tests, and reviews changes to infrastructure, data, and software prior to deployment to production.
evidence_checklist: GitHub / GitLab Pull Request Branch Protection Rule Export
CI/CD Automated Unit & Integration Test Logs
Change Advisory Board (CAB) Deployment Approval Records
controls.remediation_guidance: Enforce mandatory pull request reviews by at least one peer and block direct pushes to main/production branches.

controls.title: Risk Mitigation - Vendor Risk Management
controls.description: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with third-party vendors and subservice organizations.
evidence_checklist: Vendor Security Risk Assessment Policy
Annual SOC 2 / ISO 27001 Report Review Files for Key Vendors
controls.remediation_guidance: Perform annual vendor security reviews for all critical third-party vendors storing customer data.

controls.title: Risk Mitigation - Business Disruption & Continuity
controls.description: The entity assesses risks related to business disruption and implements business continuity and resilience measures.
evidence_checklist: Business Impact Analysis (BIA) Document
Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and Annual Test Sign-off
controls.remediation_guidance: Document Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) and Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) for all tier-1 services.

controls.title: Availability - Infrastructure & Service Performance
controls.description: The entity maintains, monitors, and evaluates processing capacity and infrastructure to meet availability commitments.
evidence_checklist: System Uptime Metrics (99.9%+ Availability Logs)
Status Page Incident & Uptime History Export
controls.remediation_guidance: Publish a public status page and configure multi-region uptime probes.

controls.title: Availability - Environmental Protections & Data Backup
controls.description: The entity executes environmental controls and performs regular data backups, protecting backups against unauthorized modification.
evidence_checklist: Database Automated Snapshot Schedule & Retention Rules
Quarterly Backup Restoration Test Execution Logs
controls.remediation_guidance: Enable daily automated encrypted database backups with 30-day retention and perform quarterly restoration tests.

controls.title: Availability - Disaster Recovery & Continuity Testing
controls.description: The entity tests recovery plan procedures to ensure systems can be restored following environmental or operational disruptions.
evidence_checklist: Disaster Recovery (DR) Plan Document
Annual DR Failover Test Execution Report & Lessons Learned
controls.remediation_guidance: Conduct an annual disaster recovery failover exercise and document system recovery times.

controls.title: Processing Integrity - Complete & Accurate Input Validation
controls.description: The entity implements policies and procedures to ensure data input into system processing is complete, accurate, and authorized.
evidence_checklist: API Schema Definition (OpenAPI / Swagger) with Validation Constraints
Input Sanitization Unit Test Suite Results
controls.remediation_guidance: Enforce strict OpenAPI request schema validation for all API entry points.

controls.title: Processing Integrity - System Processing & Data Quality
controls.description: The entity ensures processing procedures execute as intended, detecting data corruption or processing errors in real time.
evidence_checklist: Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) & Job Exception Alert Rules
Database Transaction Rollback Test Logs
controls.remediation_guidance: Implement transactional dead-letter queues and monitoring alerts for failed message processing.

controls.title: Processing Integrity - Output Validation & Distribution
controls.description: The entity validates processing output for completeness and accuracy before distribution to authorized recipients.
evidence_checklist: Output Payload Integrity Checksum Logs
Automated Report Delivery Audit Logs
controls.remediation_guidance: Include cryptographic checksums (SHA-256) on generated reports and exports.

controls.title: Processing Integrity - Data Storage & Maintenance
controls.description: The entity stores and maintains processed data safely, preventing unauthorized alteration during storage lifecycle.
evidence_checklist: Database Audit Trigger Log Configuration
Immutability Configuration for Storage Repositories
controls.remediation_guidance: Enable database table change data capture (CDC) auditing for financial and transactional tables.

controls.title: Processing Integrity - System Error Resolution
controls.description: The entity tracks, investigates, and resolves system processing errors in a timely manner.
evidence_checklist: Sentry / Application Performance Monitoring (APM) Error Tracking Dashboard
Bug Triage & Resolution SLA Metrics
controls.remediation_guidance: Integrate APM error tracking tools and enforce 48-hour resolution SLAs for critical processing errors.

controls.title: Confidentiality - Data Classification & Identification
controls.description: The entity identifies and classifies confidential information to ensure appropriate security controls are applied throughout its lifecycle.
evidence_checklist: Data Classification Policy & Scheme
Data Inventory & PII / Confidential Field Mapping Register
controls.remediation_guidance: Maintain a Data Inventory mapping all repositories storing Confidential or Sensitive data.

controls.title: Confidentiality - Confidential Data Destruction
controls.description: The entity securely disposes of confidential information when no longer required according to retention policies.
evidence_checklist: Data Retention and Lifecycle Management Policy
Automated DB Data Purge Cron Job Verification Logs
controls.remediation_guidance: Configure automated database lifecycle policies to hard-delete expired confidential records.

controls.title: Privacy - Notice of Privacy Practices
controls.description: The entity provides notice to data subjects about its privacy practices, including purpose of collection, use, and disclosure of personal information.
evidence_checklist: Public Privacy Policy Document URL
Privacy Policy Update History & Annual Review Log
controls.remediation_guidance: Publish a comprehensive Privacy Notice detailing personal data collection and third-party sharing.

controls.title: Privacy - Choice and Consent Management
controls.description: The entity informs data subjects of choices available regarding collection, use, and disclosure of personal information, obtaining consent where required.
evidence_checklist: Cookie Consent Banner & Opt-In Preference Management Implementation
Consent Audit Trail Database Logs
controls.remediation_guidance: Implement a consent management banner supporting explicit opt-in for analytics and tracking.

controls.title: Privacy - Data Collection Limitation
controls.description: The entity collects personal information only for specified, explicit, and legitimate purposes.
evidence_checklist: Data Minimization Architecture Review Sign-off
User Registration Form Field Justification Audit
controls.remediation_guidance: Audit signup forms and remove non-essential personal data collection fields.

controls.title: Privacy - Authorized Collection Methods
controls.description: The entity collects personal information through fair and lawful means, directly from data subjects or authorized third parties.
evidence_checklist: Third-Party Data Sourcing Terms & Verification Agreements
controls.remediation_guidance: Verify that all third-party data providers have obtained valid data subject consent.

controls.title: Privacy - Use and Retention Enforcement
controls.description: The entity limits the use of personal information to purposes identified in the privacy notice and retains data only as long as necessary.
evidence_checklist: Data Retention Schedule Document
Automated Inactive Account Anonymization Script Logs
controls.remediation_guidance: Automate anonymization or soft-deletion of user accounts after 12 months of inactivity.

controls.title: Privacy - Data Subject Erasure & Disposal
controls.description: The entity securely disposes of or anonymizes personal information when it is no longer needed or upon valid erasure request.
evidence_checklist: Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) Erasure Workflow
Account Deletion Audit Trail Logs
controls.remediation_guidance: Provide an automated 'Delete Account' self-service option fulfilling DSAR erasure within 30 days.

controls.title: Privacy - Data Subject Access & Rectification
controls.description: The entity provides data subjects with access to their personal information for review and correction.
evidence_checklist: User Profile Data Export & Edit UI Implementation Screenshots
DSAR Intake Channel & Resolution SLA Logs
controls.remediation_guidance: Allow users to download a copy of their personal data (JSON/CSV) from profile settings.

controls.title: Privacy - Handling Data Corrections
controls.description: The entity corrects or amends inaccurate or incomplete personal information upon verified request.
evidence_checklist: Profile Rectification Audit Logs
controls.remediation_guidance: Provide user-facing controls for instant updates to profile contact information.

controls.title: Privacy - Third-Party Disclosure Restrictions
controls.description: The entity discloses personal information to third parties only for identified purposes and with valid authorization or consent.
evidence_checklist: Data Processing Addendums (DPA) with Subprocessors
Public List of Approved Subprocessors
controls.remediation_guidance: Execute standard Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) with standard contractual clauses (SCCs) for all subprocessors.

controls.title: Privacy - Subprocessor Monitoring & Safeguards
controls.description: The entity requires third parties to provide equivalent privacy protections for personal information shared with them.
evidence_checklist: Annual Subprocessor Security Assessment Checklist
Subprocessor Notification & Opt-Out Mechanism
controls.remediation_guidance: Notify customers at least 30 days prior to engaging new subprocessors.

controls.title: Privacy - Personal Data Quality & Accuracy
controls.description: The entity takes reasonable steps to ensure personal information collected is accurate and up to date.
evidence_checklist: Email Verification & Address Validation Implementation Records
controls.remediation_guidance: Require email confirmation links during user registration.

controls.title: Privacy - Privacy Incident Reporting & Dispute Resolution
controls.description: The entity addresses privacy-related inquiries, disputes, and breach notifications to affected individuals and regulatory bodies.
evidence_checklist: Privacy Breach Notification Standard Operating Procedure
Data Protection Officer (DPO) Contact Details & Intake Channel
controls.remediation_guidance: Establish a breach notification procedure meeting 72-hour regulatory notification mandates.
